# crosswork_demand_matrix_domain (Resource)

This resource can enable the demand matrix of one domain. The controller creates the domains, so the domain must exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_demand_matrix_domain" "example" {
  domain_id = "32"
  enable    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) Domain identifier

### Optional

- `enable` (Boolean) Enables the demand matrix of the domain
  - Default value: `false`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_demand_matrix_domain.example "<domain_id>"
```
